runtime_admission.explanation: 512-wide single roles use maxima over completed earlier 512-wide single roles. For each class use the greater of summed per-opponent maxima and observed completed guard wall time. Direct games use actual earlier single-vs-V14 timing. No fresh outcomes used. All bases padded 15% plus 12 seconds per job. Two-worker greedy queue in controller order. Estimate, not a guaranteed worst case.

statistical_unit: whole card across sides and opponents
primary_method_contrast: ANCHOR minus CONTROL, separately per training seed
confirmation_screen: ANCHOR only: panel >= A2, Solution >= A2, panel > paired CONTROL, >=24/40 strict direct wins; rank panel, Solution, smaller training seed
seed_freshness_limits: Local registered worktrees only; undocumented trials or other machines are unknown.
Files without seed columns/fields do not prove non-consumption; reported explicitly.
JSON range candidates are conservative inclusive endpoints unless stop_exclusive is explicit; all candidates require adjudication before a freshness claim.
JSON seed metadata and numeric/string mentions are distinguished from actual CSV/JSONL consumption.
Only experiments/logs/replays directory trees scanned; .git/.venv/venv/node_modules/__pycache__ skipped; directory symlinks not followed.
Stored file bytes deduplicated by SHA-256 within format; compressed/uncompressed representations count separately if bytes differ.
No model, game, test, source changes, or repository writes made.
notes: Diagnostic qualifies no submission; full later confirmation/course/package checks remain required.
Training-seed effects remain separate; only two starts and 20 diagnostic cards.
Keep all frozen sources, helpers, inputs, engine files and HEAD unchanged until the controller and audit finish.
No games are launched by this preparation helper. Root performs the separate guarded launch after current operational checks.
